bullets.body: Pumapasok ang Tuesday-cycle Frontier Model Review Board executive order push sa three-business-day window bago ang May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing. Sumasali ang House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Communications and Technology Chair sa Senator Mark Warner's bipartisan Senate Cyber requesting cohort, na nagpapadala ng Tuesday-morning joint letter sa White House Office of Science and Technology Policy na humihiling na ang anumang signed executive order ay magsama ng parallel 30-day House Energy and Commerce technical review window na sumasalamin sa Senate cyber-subcommittee classified-briefing protocol. Tumitibay pa ang witness slate: kinukumpirma ng tanggapan ni Senator Warner ang ikaanim na witness, ang Federal Communications Commission Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau Chief, na sumasali sa nauna nang nakumpirma na NIST Director Locascio, ODNI cyber lead, NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director, Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center representative, at Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency Director. Naghahain ang Brennan Center for Justice at ang Center for Internet and Society sa Stanford ng joint Tuesday amicus letter na sumasali sa kasalukuyang twelve-organization coalition (AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, Lawyers for Civil Justice, Knight First Amendment Institute, Electronic Frontier Foundation, American Civil Liberties Union, Center for Democracy and Technology, plus dalawang regional bar associations at dalawang civil-society policy shops), na nakatutok sa documented State Farm reasoned-decision-record requirement plus paired sixty-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window na naka-align sa AISI cyber-evaluation reciprocity 120-day placement window. Naglalathala ang White House OSTP ng Tuesday-afternoon press-pool note na hawak ang linya na ang executive order draft ay nananatili sa interagency review nang walang signing window bago ang May 22.

Kinukumpirma ng Hyundai Robotics Metaplant Application Center na ang Atlas humanoid-policy LoRA fine-tune rollout sa full 60-unit Hyundai Steel Dangjin rolling-mill commercial roster ay natapos Tuesday morning Korea time, kasama ng post-rollout cycle-time improvement sa rolling-mill pickup motion na nag-i-stabilize sa 4.6 percent kumpara sa pre-tune baseline (umakyat mula sa 4.1 percent first-result figure na inilathala Monday). Naglalathala ang Metaplant ng Tuesday Korea-time note na naglalarawan sa policy-distillation pipeline bilang unang sa production-scale humanoid robotics upang i-compose ang Tenstorrent Galaxy rack plus ang Unsloth router-only LoRA recipe plus ang multi-GPU NCCL backend end-to-end. Pinapagana ang Wolfsburg pilot ng Volkswagen Group Tuesday morning Europe time kasama ng 24-unit Atlas allocation sa body-shop welding-jig material-handoff task, na sumasali sa Kia Slovak Zilina paint-line subassembly (24-unit, ikaapat na full shift cycle na natapos Tuesday nang walang MTBF-impacting incidents) at sa LG Energy Solution Holland Michigan cell-stacking inspection pilot (ngayon ay 30 active units active, na nai-kumpleto ang buong 30-unit allocation Tuesday).

bullets.body: Pinapalawak ng Tuesday arxiv landings ang signed-checkpoint plus sovereign-cloud composition verification waves at idinaragdag ang sariwang agentic-AI evaluation framework. Pinapalawak ng Verifiable Cross-Hemispheric Composition for Agentic AI under Mixed-Reciprocity Regimes (arxiv 2605.06584) ang Monday End-to-End Sovereign-Cloud Composition Verification paper kasama ng formal verification ng jurisdiction-boundary-crossing capability gating sa buong eleven-jurisdiction Indo-Pacific cohort plus ang bagong Chile at Mexico exploratory observer track, na nagbibigay ng compositional safety theorems para sa cross-hemispheric reciprocity-attestation field schemas; ang paper ay co-authored ng mga researchers mula sa MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, Anthropic, Microsoft, ang EU AI Office, plus ang OECD GENAI working group secretariat. Stable Long-Context Reinforcement Learning via Router-Aware Advantage Decomposition (arxiv 2605.05844 v5) ay nagdaragdag ng Tuesday extension na nagpapakita na ang teknik ay nagsasara ng long-context training-stability gap sa bagong dual-Hopper kernel-fused tensor-parallel router-attention backward pass setup mula sa Unsloth Tuesday changelog, kasama ng pre-tested integration laban sa vLLM v0.11.3 signed-checkpoint loader. Nag-ship ang Cross-Vendor Agentic-AI Evaluation Harness for Mixed-Loader Frameworks (arxiv 2605.06641) ng Tuesday evaluation harness na sumasaklaw sa eight-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader pattern; nagbibigay ang paper ng reference test suite na nangakong patatakbuhin ng LangChain, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, Haystack, LiteLLM, at Pydantic AI maintainer teams sa continuous integration bago ang mid-June signed-checkpoint default-shipment target.

bullets.body: Nag-co-publish ang DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft ng Tuesday joint follow-up preprint sa agentic-AI runtime-verifier integration. Pinapalawak ng Runtime Signature-Verification and Manifest-Allowlist Enforcement for Agentic AI Inference Pipelines (arxiv 2605.06712) ang Monday Signed-Checkpoint and Manifest-Allowlist Verification paper upang saklawin ang inference-routing tier na inilantad ng Tuesday Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 disclosure, na nagmumungkahi ng runtime-verifier integration pattern na compatible sa buong LangChain LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, Haystack, LiteLLM, at Pydantic AI cohort plus ang OpenAI Codex CLI v3.1.0 signature-verified manifest-allowlist-validation upgrade na nag-ship ngayong Tuesday; nagbibigay ang paper ng reference implementations sa Python at Rust plus formal compositional safety proofs na sumasaklaw sa eight-CVE pattern instances na nasa scope ngayon. Naglalathala ang Microsoft, LangChain, ang CrewAI maintainer team, plus ang Pydantic AI maintainer team ng parallel Tuesday commitments na mag-ship sa runtime-verifier integration bilang default sa susunod na minor-version release ng bawat respektibong framework, kasama ng coordinated mid-June default-shipment target window na pinalawak na ngayon upang saklawin ang inference-routing tier mitigation bilang paired delivery sa tabi ng load-time signed-checkpoint primitive.
